summary: Iteration 5: Full E2E on Premium features (390x844) with speed_test@t.com/test123. ALL 4 backend suites and ALL 7 frontend flows PASS. Backend pytest: 12/12 green in ~11s. Frontend: (1) AI Copilot returns REAL Claude output — markdown-formatted 5 SaaS ideas with emojis, monetization amounts, and a personalized 'my top pick' recommendation (no longer the MOCK placeholder). (2) Matches shows 'Aisha Patel · Marketer · Toronto · 90%' with gold 'Deal Room' pill per row. (3) Tapping Deal Room navigates to the existing 'Founders CRM' room. (4) Overview tab shows VISION card, stats grid (0/1 Tasks done, 0 Phases, 2 Founders), AI CTA 'Generate a 90-day roadmap'. (5) Tasks tab: add-task input + gold '+' button works, added task appears immediately, tapping checkbox strikes it through and shows a gold checkmark. (6) Roadmap tab shows empty state with 'No roadmap yet' + 'Let AI generate a 90-day roadmap...' + gold 'Generate roadmap' CTA (backend equivalent generate-roadmap tested indirectly via 3-tab existence check; live generation ~15-25s not exercised to keep run fast). (7) Profile → Edit profile opens a modal with Photos/Full name/Bio/City/Country/Skills/Objectives fields; edited bio + added skill 'TEST_Skill_X'; hitting the gold checkmark save button persisted both fields — verified via GET /api/auth/me. No regressions to Discover, Auth, Projects. Only remaining non-blocking issues are two RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents) already reported in iteration_4.

integration_issues.issue: If a prior session's token in localStorage is expired/invalid, the app still renders the tab shell and target screens (Matches shows 'No matches yet', Copilot shows 'Something went wrong: Unauthorized') instead of routing back to /login. api/client.ts already removes the token on 401 and throws 'Unauthorized', but nothing observes this to bounce the user to the login screen. Non-blocking (a manual localStorage.clear() + fresh login works), but should be handled by AuthContext listening for 401 and clearing user state.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/profile/update correctly uses a whitelist and returns 400 when no valid keys are provided. It also invalidates compatibility_cache by regex on the user_id — good.
server.py POST /api/ai/copilot/chat is properly auth-gated (Depends(get_current_user)) and streams to a concatenated string, then returns {response: str}. Uses claude-sonnet-4-6 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
server.py deal-room task endpoints correctly enforce room-participant authorization; toggle_task PATCH persists tasks[] via $set. Good.
server.py GET /api/matches/{match_id}/deal-room returns {room: null} idempotently — matches the create-vs-existing branching in frontend deal-room/[matchId].tsx.
Frontend deal-room/[matchId].tsx and profile/edit.tsx follow the theme, use SafeAreaView with edges=['top'], and have complete testID coverage on every interactive element.

Minor DX: api/client.ts silently removes token on 401 but does not surface an event/state change to AuthContext, so protected screens end up rendering their empty state instead of redirecting to login.

rca_of_issue: Not a bug in the delivered features, but a UX observation surfaced during testing: when a stale token exists in web localStorage from a previous session, the app renders protected screens (Matches shows 'No matches yet', Copilot shows 'Something went wrong: Unauthorized') instead of bouncing back to /login. Root cause: api/client.ts on HTTP 401 removes the token from storage and throws Error('Unauthorized'), but nothing at the layout/AuthContext layer subscribes to this to reset user state or redirect. Mitigation: in AuthContext.tsx, on every mount check /api/auth/me and clear user + route to /login if it fails, OR emit a global logout event from api/client.ts on 401 that AuthContext listens for.
